title: PSG4-SECOND-SCALE-BANK: counted linear classical storage with sharper time and source bounds

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), L=log2n, the ONE physical PSG4-SECOND-SCALE-BANK interpreter in proof.md executes the complete scoped PSG4-SECOND-SCALE program in virtual.md with fixed q=1/2,alpha=3/8,alpha2=7/16,eta=3/4. It uses exhaustive testing for n<256 and otherwise computes ell_base=ceil(log2n), g_base largest integer with g_base^8*ell_base^3<=n^4, g2_base largest integer with g2_base^16*ell_base^7<=n^8, u=min(R,max(1,floor(R/3)+max(0,2g_base-floor(17g2_base/36)))), and the first exact C4096 profile with2S_u(R)>=n, recomputing every source/decoder/precision/acquisition/weighted-work quantity. It recovers the entire secret from independent ideal copies with unconditional success at least1-2^-8>2/3. Jointly on EVERY branch including failed work, discarded copies, wrong labels, both aborts, full padded bank growth, source moves and output-first cleanup, paid physical time T is O(2^((3/4)sqrt(nL)+(3/4)sqrt(n)L^(-3/8)-(1/24)sqrt(n)L^(-7/16))) with exact growth index1/2. All outside constants are absolute. The full CQ induction preserves output and source-request laws; the separately paid polynomial interpreter fits the strict G2/48 margin in the internal time theorem. Every basis/coherent/padding/source wire, typed metadata, root arithmetic, generated gate, address fee, reset and cleanup count jointly with both physical spaces, source cap, unconditional success and clean fraction0. No virtual memory columns are substituted.

For the same PSG4-SECOND-SCALE-BANK algorithm and complete parameter rule in proof.md, the proved malformed-sample fractional guarantee is epsilon(n)=0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N>=2 and every s, unconditional full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted, and this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
